originalIntent: Euro NCAP VRU AEB Bicyclist protocols (CBNA nearside adult, CBFA farside, CBLA longitudinal). A cyclist conflict is distinguished from a pedestrian one by the closing speed, so the band is tighter, not looser. Bands are pre-registered from published test protocols, not fitted to observed results.
title: Cyclist or powered-two-wheeler conflict: a narrow VRU in or entering the ego path
